part.text: The scientific consensus is clear: there is no credible evidence linking the MMR vaccine to autism. This claim has been thoroughly debunked by numerous studies and health organizations. For detailed information, refer to the [WHO vaccine safety page](https://www.who.int/health-topics/vaccines) and [CDC vaccine FAQs](https://www.cdc.gov/vaccines/parents/faq.html). Always consult peer-reviewed research or medical guidelines for authoritative answers.
